evidence.label: periosteal woven bone; no radiological callus

amendments.trigger: ST13 design 706 in the text-based reconstruction does not reproduce the ST13 in vivo courses
amendments.change: Recalibration protocol (ST13 LHS + PSO on cases A, B); criteria K1-K4 fixed before the run
amendments.outcome: K1, K2, K4 pass; K3 fail (mean V1-V4 7.09)

amendments.change: LOO-CV over six cases with criterion L1 (CV mean <= 2); revascularization-rate variant with predictions P1-P4
amendments.outcome: L1 fail (CV mean 9.54 baseline, 9.71 rate); rate hypothesis rejected (P1-P4 fail)

amendments.change: Freeze with SHA-256 hashes; digitized ST13 published simulated curves as benchmark
amendments.outcome: ST13 published curves: mean V1-V4 error 3.51

amendments.trigger: Reproduction gap between reconstruction and published curves
amendments.change: Diagnostic variants with design 706, no fitting
amendments.outcome: Mesh dependence (V2 e 26.8 / 19.2 / 6.3 on three meshes); early stiffening is cartilage-driven

amendments.change: Exact centroid defuzzification; sub-stepping; A_ref per mesh for 0.22 mm/day; mesh-convergence criterion 0.02 mm; cartilage output variants cart50/cart30
amendments.outcome: n = 1 propagation limit; perfusion front 0.63 mm/day with sub-steps; table defect

amendments.change: Revascularization factor mu set for a 0.22 mm/day perfusion front; n in {4, 8, 16, 32}; mesh M5 added
amendments.outcome: Both fronts 0.22 mm/day; low-IFM cases converge (<= 0.015 mm); B and V3 do not (union/non-union switch); rule selects M5/n32 (about 20 h per calibration)

amendments.trigger: M5/n32 computationally infeasible for calibration and LOO; exploratory feasibility probe (52 designs) bimodal
amendments.change: Two fidelities (calibrate M3/n16, report M4/n32); LOO only if a variant passes K1 at M4/n32; exploratory time-scale scan
amendments.outcome: cart50 K1 fail; cart30 K1 pass, K3 fail (10.81), 7 parameters at bounds; scan: no single front speed fits low- and high-IFM cases

amendments.trigger: cart30 passes K1 at M4/n32 (pre-set rule)
amendments.change: LOO for cart30, baseline parameter set; held-out errors at M4/n32; rate variant not run (deviation, reason stated)
Post hoc analysis of 4,124 cached designs (no new runs)
amendments.outcome: B-V2 Pareto gap: no design with e_B and e_V2 both < 21.78; objective multimodal

amendments.trigger: v2 structural failure; decision to test structural extensions (rule written before the run)
amendments.change: Screen 1: front speed <= 0.22 mm/day with larger healing region (mCI 2-3.5); two fixed designs
Screen 2: callus moduli below ST13 bounds (Leong & Morgan 2008)
Screen 3: onset delay, evaluated exactly as a time shift of existing runs
Registration: design 706 fixed; onset delay tau (0-35 d) and mCI (2.0-3.5) on an exhaustive grid; calibrate A + B; K1-K3, L1 at M4/n32; V5 excluded (outside geometry)
amendments.outcome: K1, K2 pass; K3 fail (7.21); L1 fail (CV mean 2.52, median 1.16; v2: 13.17)

amendments.change: 12 ST13 parameters + tau + mCI, LHS + PSO on A + B, M3/n16, reported at M4/n32
amendments.outcome: K1, K2, K4 pass; K3 fail (8.48); tau not identifiable from A + B (G <= 1.05 for tau 8-19 d)

amendments.change: Freeze of v2 and v3 with SHA-256 hashes
amendments.outcome: No further fitting or model variants for Paper 2a

amendments.change: Literature check of the freeze form against early sheep callus histology (no simulation)
amendments.outcome: Freeze form incompatible with woven bone at 2 weeks (Epari 2006, Vetter 2010); tau reported as an effective latency of the IFM response
